sources.text: NeurIPS 2027 Call for Papers: Main Track submissions are open for original empirical and theoretical research. Double-blind anonymity policy enforced with fixed page limits and reproducibility checklist. Author registration fees and travel grant schedules are published cleanly on the official portal.

Findings of ACL 2027 Call for Papers invites concise findings and bounded empirical analyses. Submissions must pass double-blind anonymity and full-text artifact reporting standards. Author registration fees and fee schedule are published cleanly on the official portal.

ICML 2027 Call for Papers: Workshop track welcomes preliminary results, negative findings, and early studies. Short 4-page archival or non-archival submissions follow double-blind anonymity formatting rules. Author registration fees and schedule are published cleanly on the official portal.
